title: Dynamic Doppler Effects on Dirac Spinor Fields
summary: We derive the dynamic Doppler effects of noninertial observer motion on Dirac spinor fields in 4D spacetime, characterizing how proper acceleration, proper jolt (also known as jerk), observer path curvature, torsion, and hyper-torsion modify the inertial quantum description of free particles. We delineate the impacts of nonlinear observer motion on the amplitude and phase of the Dirac spinor wave field and isolate the spin-induced signatures that have no counterpart in the scalar Klein-Gordon field.
